CTRL_MRM_004.description: Traditional quantitative model validation for non-agentic, deterministic ML components. MAS TRM Guidelines §6.3 require a documented AI/ML governance framework covering model development, validation, deployment, and monitoring. MAS FEAT Fairness Principle F2 expects quantitative fairness metrics (demographic parity, equalized odds) to be computed and documented during validation. SR 26-2 is a US Federal Reserve guidance document with no legal standing in Singapore.
